name: Brooks Day Camp – Group 3 (Ages 8-10)
description_short: A day camp for ages 8 to 10 at Brooks School in North Andover, run in two-week sessions from 8:30 AM drop-off to 4:30 PM pick-up. Campers rotate through athletics, arts, nature and swim, and also get daily choice blocks where they pick their own activities.
swim_waterfront_notes: Daily swim lessons and free swim are included. The aquatics program is run by an Aquatics Supervisor who is lifeguard certified and a Certified Pool Operator. Boating & fishing and paddle sports are also on the activity list.
